workflows.name: Automated Report & Dashboard Building
workflows.desc: Turn raw numbers into a polished, styled report or live dashboard on demand.
workflows.currentProcess: A person exports data, builds charts, and formats a slide deck or doc every reporting cycle.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS reads the source data, calculates the KPIs, builds the charts, and renders a branded HTML/PDF report or live dashboard automatically.
workflows.dependencies: Access to the source data (a sheet, export, or connected tool).

workflows.name: Spreadsheet Build & Data Automation
workflows.desc: Create, populate, and format Google Sheets with formulas, tabs, and validation.
workflows.currentProcess: Staff manually build spreadsheets, type data, and set up formulas and formatting by hand.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS creates the workbook, structures tabs, writes formulas and dropdowns, and populates it via the Google Sheets API.
workflows.dependencies: A connected Google account (already connected here).

workflows.name: Google Drive File Organization
workflows.desc: Scan a Drive, sort files into folders, rename to convention, and report actions.
workflows.currentProcess: Someone manually drags files into folders and renames them to match naming rules.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS scans the folder, applies your naming and foldering rules, moves and renames files, and returns a report of every action.
workflows.dependencies: A connected Google Drive (already connected here).

workflows.name: Market & Competitive Research
workflows.desc: Multi-source web research synthesized into a cited, decision-ready brief.
workflows.currentProcess: A person googles, opens dozens of tabs, copies notes, and writes up findings over hours.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS fans out parallel web searches, fetches and verifies sources, and synthesizes a cited brief, flagging anything uncertain.
workflows.dependencies: Public web sources; paywalled/authenticated data needs access.

workflows.name: Document & PDF Data Extraction
workflows.desc: Pull structured fields out of PDFs and documents into a clean spreadsheet.
workflows.currentProcess: Staff read PDFs and retype key fields into a spreadsheet one document at a time.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS reads each PDF, extracts the fields you specify, and writes them into a structured sheet with an exceptions list for review.

workflows.name: Marketing Graphic Creation
workflows.desc: Generate on-brand social and marketing graphics from a brief.
workflows.currentProcess: A designer builds each graphic by hand, resizing and restyling per platform.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS generates platform-sized, on-brand images from a prompt and brand kit, and saves them for review.

workflows.name: Content Drafting & Repurposing
workflows.desc: Draft copy and turn one asset into blog, email, and social variants.
workflows.currentProcess: A writer rewrites one source piece into each channel format by hand.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS drafts in your voice and repurposes a single source into channel-ready blog, email, and social posts for review.
workflows.dependencies: A brand voice guide sharpens output.

workflows.name: Calendar & Scheduling Coordination
workflows.desc: Read availability, create events, and coordinate scheduling.
workflows.currentProcess: Staff check calendars, email back and forth, and create events manually.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS reads the connected calendar, proposes times, and creates events with the right invitees and details.

workflows.name: Web Form & Page Automation
workflows.desc: Drive a headless browser to fill public forms, capture data, and monitor pages.
workflows.currentProcess: A person manually visits sites, fills forms, and copies data or watches for changes.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS uses a headless browser to complete public forms, scrape and screenshot pages, and flag changes on a schedule.
workflows.dependencies: Public pages/forms; authenticated logins need a connected credential or a hand-off.

workflows.name: GitHub Repository & Issue Automation
workflows.desc: Triage issues, draft PRs, and run routine repo tasks.
workflows.currentProcess: A developer manually labels issues, writes summaries, and handles repetitive repo chores.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS triages and labels issues, drafts pull requests and release notes, and automates routine repo tasks via the GitHub API.
workflows.dependencies: A connected GitHub account (already connected here).

workflows.name: Email Drafting & Outreach Prep
workflows.desc: Draft and personalize outreach and replies, ready for approved sending.
workflows.currentProcess: Staff write and personalize each email by hand and track who to follow up with.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS drafts personalized outreach and replies from your inputs and queues them; sending runs through a connected email integration with your approval.
workflows.dependencies: Sending requires a connected email integration and your sign-off.

workflows.name: Multi-Step Workflow Orchestration
workflows.desc: Coordinate many sub-agents to run large audits, migrations, and reviews.
workflows.currentProcess: A team manually splits big projects into pieces, tracks them, and stitches results together.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS plans the work, runs specialized agents in parallel, verifies findings, and synthesizes one result for large multi-step jobs.
workflows.dependencies: A clearly scoped objective; more depth scales with the effort allowed.

workflows.name: Live Q&A Assistant Over Your Data
workflows.desc: Answer grounded questions about your workflows, tools, and numbers on demand.
workflows.currentProcess: People dig through docs and spreadsheets to answer the same questions repeatedly.
workflows.autoRec: MAVIS answers natural-language questions grounded in your data instantly, with links to the underlying detail.
workflows.dependencies: A source of truth for MAVIS to read.
